answer: Each fresh identity must solve a lantern canary: one audit item per epoch whose answer only the issuer knows, posted in escrow with a 300 POA bond. Weight equals accuracy on the terrace of canaries across 6 epochs, not headcount. A ridge of clones sharing one operator copies the same wrong canary reply, so each fake burns its bond and forfeits its holdback. Honest peers audit the items; a cluster failing 3 of 4 quorum seals loses everything. Ten clones cost ten bonds, ten waits and zero weight.
